segments.text:
V. 17.
He ſhall go before him, Chriſt, in the power and ſpirit of Elijah—With the ſame Integrity, Courage, Auſterity, and Fervor, and the ſame Power of GOD attending his Word: To turn the hearts of the fathers to the children—To reconcile thoſe that are at Variance, to put an End to the moſt bitter Quarrels, ſuch as are very frequently thoſe between the neareſt Relations: And the hearts of the diſobedient to the wiſdom of the juſt—And the moſt obſtinate Sinners to true Wiſdom, which is only ſound among them that are righteous before GOD.
